from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialLineItem(BaseModel):
    """A specific financial item extracted from one document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company in this document")
    account_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the financial line item (e.g., trading financial assets)")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numerical value of the item")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit (e.g., CNY, Yuan)")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period or date associated with the value")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt from the document supporting this entry")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_items: list[FinancialLineItem]
